name: Invoke-AI
description: An implementation of Stable Diffusion, the open source text-to-image and image-to-image generator, providing a streamlined process with various new features and options to aid the image generation process. **Nvidia GPU Use:** Using the Unraid Nvidia Plugin to install a version of Unraid with the Nvidia Drivers installed and add **--runtime=nvidia --gpus=all** to "extra parameters" (switch on advanced view) **AMD GPU Use:** For AMD GPU support, add "/dev/kfd" and "/dev/dri" each as a Device and add the required Variables: https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/install-on-linux/en/latest/how-to/docker.html#accessing-gpus-in-containers
